scope: Offline real-browser response race, errors and token isolation.

checks.name: All four screens fit 320, 390, 768 and 1440 pixel viewports
Direct typing auto-creates one session and sends once; failed session creation preserves draft
Suggested question starts a session and prefills without sending
Disabled engine shows truthful 503 without an invented assistant answer
Known rejection enables composer and new conversation without an automatic resend
Enter sends once; Shift+Enter leaves the native newline behavior available
Delayed institute response cannot overwrite fitness data after business switch
Rejected message and owning session remain associated with original business
Next proxy preserves page cursor/query and rejects a foreign session token
400, 404 and terminal failed-turn responses have an explicit next-session path
Uncertain delivery retries the exact body; leaving warns and does not resend
Malformed success fails closed and retains the original message for exact replay
Malformed 404 error is treated as uncertain and keeps the original pending message
Structurally valid foreign-business page is rejected before display
Selecting another conversation hides old history while its new response is delayed
A delayed earlier file cannot overwrite the newer selected document content
Refresh documents reloads selected detail and displays updated ingestion status
Open reader shows failed reads and retries successfully without closing
Rapid More clicks issue one cursor request and append no duplicate records
Real Mongo lead REST projection renders callback, summary and mock notification; absent schedule is not invented
Lead UI keeps institute fixture data out of the fitness business
Initial backend outage renders a retryable connection error
